audit: T2 orphan-link definedness and attached non-link road support; diagnostic only

interpretation.no_fit: The measured support-backed gate fails; no follow-on model was fit.
interpretation.registered_T2_defined_mask_is_not_suppor: T2-v1's emitted mask may define zero-valued tracts; it does not imply any attached non-link road exists. Report native definedness and positive attached support separately.
interpretation.target_limit: No target accuracy or causal interpretation is claimed.

measure_before.metric_context: prior county-held-out ΔR² on frozen S1 estimator-disagreement residual; not target accuracy

follow_on_model_decision.reason: native T2 masks pass, but the support-backed coverage requirement fails; no follow-on model was fit

native_definedness_gate.criterion: at least 80% defined overall and at least 50% defined in every region

support_backed_follow_on_gate.criterion: at least 80% of official tracts have positive eligible attached non-link support overall and at least 50% in every region
support_backed_follow_on_gate.reason: effective attached-road support is below the frozen coverage gate; do not fit a follow-on model

eastern-ok.audit: T2 orphan-link definedness and attached non-link road support; diagnostic only

method.RUCA_strata: provided ruca_primary codes with ruca_covered; code 99 is preserved as its own provided category; uncovered/null/nonintegral values are explicit missing_or_uncovered
method.T2_v1_feature: registered covariate:orphan_link_length_km; in-tract length of qualifying orphan link segments, not attached carriageways
method.orphan_rule: link-class/subclass segment with both endpoint connectors attached to other roads and no named-class neighbor at either endpoint
method.support_definition: at least one qualifying endpoint-attached non-named non-link road contributes positive in-tract length after clipping to the 2,000 m buffer around an orphan link

t2_exact_diagnostics.connector_rule: both endpoint neighbors non-named; named neighbor disqualifies
